rate_offered.notes: Printed '(3.00%)P-1.75%' (adjusted '3.0000%'), variable, 'לא צמוד', standing order. FIBI publishes no three-year monthly plan; its standing-order plans run 4 to 30 years. This one is the closest unlinked plan whose exit points include the 36-month mark ('בתום שנתיים וכל שנה לאחר מכן'). The other short one, 'חסכון גמיש ל-4 שנים' (286/463), pays '(0.25%)P-4.5%' with monthly exit points from 50 NIS.
